now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
now.text: Mantis kicks Master Karja to the ground when his Orgosentries corner her and Drax at the Orgoscope. Karja shoots Drax and forces her to surrender, until Peter Quill hacks his suit and frees them.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Orgocorp chief Mantis kicks down, who forces her surrender.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who kicks Karja down before he forces her to surrender.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Orgoscope's security chief, whom Mantis kicks down before he forces her surrender.

changes.evidence: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3: Karja is Master Karja, head of security on the Orgoscope (Orgocorp's headquarters); Orgocorp is led by the High Evolutionary. 'The Orgocorp chief' reads as the head of Orgocorp, which he is not. Mantis kicks him to the ground at the spaceport, then he shoots Drax and makes her surrender.
